_about: Registry of the nine Proax sourcing sites. One entry per domain. Used by the catalog export (search terms) and as the brief for building each next site. Order = suggested build order.

sites.name: TerminalBlock.ca
sites.tool: Terminal block finder + photo / part-number identifier
sites.world: Inside a control cabinet: DIN rail, grey/blue/green-yellow blocks

sites.name: Contactors.ca
sites.tool: Contactor cross-reference finder (coil voltage, AC-3 rating, frame size)
sites.signature: Coil-voltage tags (24 VDC, 120 VAC) on every part
sites.world: Motor control centres and starter panels

sites.name: SafetyRelays.ca
sites.tool: Safety relay comparison tool (inputs, outputs, PL/SIL, reset type)
sites.signature: Performance level badge (PL d / PL e) shown as quiet text

sites.name: SafetySwitches.ca
sites.category: Safety interlock, door and hinge switches
sites.tool: Safety switch finder (guard type, coding level, locking)

sites.name: SafetyLightCurtains.ca
sites.tool: Light curtain selection assistant (resolution, protective height, safety distance)
sites.signature: Beam lines and resolution tags (14 mm / 30 mm)
sites.world: Press brakes, robot cells and conveyors

sites.name: SolidStateRelays.ca
sites.category: Solid state relays and heat sinks
sites.tool: Relay replacement finder (load current, voltage, switching type, heat sink)

sites.name: UPSPowerSupply.ca
sites.category: DIN-rail power supplies and DC UPS
sites.tool: UPS sizing calculator (load, hold-up time, battery size)

sites.name: Actuators.ca
sites.tool: Actuator selection tool (stroke, force, speed, mounting)

sites.name: PneumaticValves.ca
sites.tool: Pneumatic valve identification tool (ports, function, voltage, manifold)
